name: 0.1-74-30d0863
notes: Orbit moments: the plume blooms as the air thins and the upper stage lights with a flash. The upper stage's inset is redrawn in the cartoon look: the cap pops off and tumbles away, the satellite unfolds its wings in steps, raises its dish and catches the sun over Earth's limb.

name: 0.1-72-02c5ecb
notes: Clouds to fly through, a vapor cone at max-Q, the sky turning black and Earth's limb rising into view. The gravity turn now starts gently at 1 km and never swings faster than 2.5 degrees a second in thick air; leaning past the limit gives you 0.7 s to come back, with the LEAN bar flashing red.

name: 0.1-68-e362152
notes: Upper-stage inset appears only once the stage leaves the screen. Finished flights wait for a tap instead of restarting on autopilot.

name: 0.1-66-87439e5
notes: Fixes the crash about a minute into a flight (music fade); keeps the smooth-frames fix from 64

name: 0.1-64-d365c47
notes: Fixes the once-a-second freeze and the liftoff hitch: music no longer blocks drawing
